sample_unit: patients (chest X-rays referred from the emergency department)

links.outcome: AI sensitivity/specificity on local ED chest X-rays vs senior radiologist reference standard
links.effect: Sensitivity 100% for fracture and pneumothorax, AI 76% for opacity, 60% for effusion, but only 33% for pulmonary nodules versus resident 75%; NPV above 95%, AUC above 0.8.
links.quote: The resident showed moderate sensitivity (75%) for pulmonary nodules, while AI's sensitivity was low (33%).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation comparing commercial AI software (Arterys MICA) to a radiology resident against a senior radiologist gold standard on emergency department chest X-rays. Does not test a deployment practice or workflow safeguard.
